categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing of Flexible Printed Circuits (FPC), Wire Harnesses, and related electronic interconnection products. It also engages in the production of LED modules and components for the electronics industry, including NB (notebook) and AI-related applications. The business includes subsidiaries such as COMPLEX MICRO INTERCONNECTION CO., LTD, GOOD VISION ELECTRONIC CO., LTD, and Cmi (Thailand) Co., Ltd.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including SMT (Surface Mount Technology), AI integration in production, and high-density interconnection (HDI) PCB technologies. It emphasizes quality certifications such as ISO 9000, ISO 14000, and IATF-16949, and employs processes like MPI, LCP, and LED module assembly. The firm also focuses on environmental management and sustainable production methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major electronics manufacturers in the notebook, AI, LED, and automotive sectors. The company serves Tier 1 suppliers and OEMs requiring high-quality interconnection solutions. Its products are integral to industries such as consumer electronics, automotive electronics, and LED lighting markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover Taiwan as the primary base, with significant manufacturing and sales presence in China and Thailand through subsidiaries. The company targets global markets, leveraging its Thailand subsidiary and international partnerships to serve customers worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, focusing on the production of interconnection components like FPCs and wire harnesses that are critical inputs for downstream electronics assembly and manufacturing. It acts as a Tier 1 supplier to major electronics manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AI integration in manufacturing, expanding HDI PCB capabilities, and developing LED module technologies. The company invests in R&D to enhance product quality, environmental sustainability, and production efficiency. It also emphasizes compliance with international standards and ESG initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of FPCs, wire harnesses, LED modules, and related electronic components. The company’s income is derived from long-term contracts with OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in the electronics industry, with a focus on volume production and quality assurance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading supplier in the FPC and wire harness market segments, competing with other specialized interconnection manufacturers. It maintains competitive advantages through technological innovation, quality certifications, and strategic geographic presence. Its subsidiaries enhance its market reach and product portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenues exceeding 2.4 billion NTD with a growth rate of approximately 10.89% year-over-year. It has a solid financial scale with assets and equity supporting ongoing expansion. The growth trajectory is supported by increased demand in AI, LED, and notebook markets, as well as strategic investments in R&D and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, reliable interconnection solutions with advanced technology integration such as AI and HDI PCB manufacturing. Its commitment to environmental sustainability, international certifications, and customer-centric innovation differentiates it in the competitive electronics components market. The firm offers comprehensive product lines and global service capabilities through its subsidiaries.
